summary: Make the Client/Customer clickable and redirect to Halo to browse tickets or more details

transcript.content: Make the Client/Customer clickable and redirect to Halo to browse tickets or more details

Nice, straightforward idea — since the AI already matches each call to a HaloPSA contact (and often an existing ticket), a clickable link there is very doable. One question: when you click the client, would you rather it open that matched Halo ticket directly, or the contact's page in Halo so you can browse all their tickets?

That's plenty — a clickable client name that opens their page in Halo from the review queue detail pane, using the contact the AI has already matched. I have what I need, so go ahead and press Submit.
